entries.headline: Presidential aircraft and military transport activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a presidential aircraft airborne over the United States, six military transport aircraft active over the North Sea and elsewhere, and a surveillance aircraft sighting. The visible post did not identify callsigns or destinations.

entries.headline: War Watch shares Reuters report of Putin warning
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a Reuters report that Putin described the world as being in a dangerous moment and warned the West against escalation, crediting @Robertchester-j5b. The post relays a reported statement rather than an observed military operation.

entries.headline: US transports, surveillance sighting and drone attack reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and a US surveillance aircraft spotted near Europe. It also described a Ukrainian drone attack into western Russia as ongoing at the time of the post, without detailing targets or outcomes.

entries.headline: Six US transports and earlier surveillance sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and an earlier surveillance aircraft sighting. It described activity as normal that night without identifying callsigns, destinations or missions.

entries.headline: Six heavy transport aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne at the time of its update, describing the count as well above the usual number for that hour. The post did not specify their locations or destinations.

entries.headline: Six transports, surveillance aircraft and radio monitoring reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States. It also reported no coded radio broadcasts detected during the hour preceding the post.

entries.headline: Transport and nuclear command aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and nuclear command jets airborne over the United States, and a surveillance aircraft spotted earlier that day near the Atlantic.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of attack into western Russia
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report credited to @reagan0965 describing an ongoing Ukrainian drone and missile attack into western Russia and claiming hundreds of drones in the area. The visible post did not provide a complete account of targets or outcomes.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Mi-8 crash report near Voronezh
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an OSINTtechnical report that a Russian Mi-8 helicopter crashed during a mission over Voronezh with no survivors, crediting @reagan0965. The post does not independently confirm the crash or provide a casualty count.

entries.headline: Six US Air Force transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, describing the number as above its usual level for that hour. The post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Baltic Sea NATO security initiative report shared
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a report that Marines would support a NATO security initiative in the Baltic Sea, crediting @reagan0965. The post did not identify the units, deployment schedule or detailed tasks.

entries.headline: SAM582 C-40B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Boeing C-40B with callsign SAM582, hex code AE11F8 and registration 02-0042, identifying it with the US Air Force 89th Airlift Wing and crediting reagan0965. The post did not specify its current location or mission.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-3 departure alert at Magong
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a Taiwan-registered military P-3 Orion at Magong, Taiwan. The alert reported a departure but did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: ASY169 P-8 ground alert at Kadena
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for ASY169, an Australian-registered military P-8 Poseidon, at Kadena, Japan. The post did not confirm the purpose of the stop.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 at Orange Park, Florida. No callsign was supplied, and the aircraft's activity on the ground was not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Kadambuttur
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military-operated P-8 near Kadambuttur, India. The alert did not identify a callsign or confirm the flight's destination or mission.

entries.headline: TRDT2 P-8 ground alert near Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported TRDT2, an Australia-registered military P-8, on the ground near Burton, Australia. The alert did not confirm its mission or operational purpose.

entries.headline: UAV15 MQ-9 ground alert near Ridgecrest
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported UAV15, identified as a US-registered MQ-9 Reaper, on the ground near Ridgecrest, California. The post did not confirm a specific mission.

entries.headline: TRDT P-8 ground alert near Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported TRDT, an Australia-registered military P-8, on the ground near Burton, Australia. This is a separate post from the TRDT2 alert; the post does not confirm the aircraft's mission.

entries.headline: New E-6 departure alert at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered E-6 at Midwest City, Oklahoma. The post discusses general communication roles but does not confirm the flight's mission.

entries.headline: DEPOT11 E-2 departure alert at Coronado
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for DEPOT11, identified as a US-registered E-2, near Coronado, United States. The alert reports departure status without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a US military P-8 on the ground near Oak Harbor, Washington. The alert gives aircraft type and ground status without confirming its mission.

entries.headline: New P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military-operated P-8 at Orange Park, Florida. The alert does not identify a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: EAGLE34 E-2 ground alert at Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported EAGLE34, identified as a US Navy E-2 Hawkeye, on the ground at Port Hueneme, California. The alert gives the aircraft's ground status; it does not confirm a specific mission.
